rationale: Reference baseline and lineage root of the fifth front forward, not a candidate and not a physical claim. Tip law: the stored values of the root of bass_front-wsp-v1 (persistence: the tip keeps the speed the prefix shows), copied statement by statement by tools/wsp/front5_edits.py, without the quench hazard this spec does not have. Boundary law: a neutral setting chosen from the bounds of the spec so that the sample always ignites and a flame never goes out (header of the edits file); it says nothing about any material. Candidates and carries of bass_front-wsp-v5 are literal revisions of this release.
